vhaineshadow.name: Vhaine, Unwound
vhaineshadow.intro: You brought a *sword* to the end of the world?

tollbaron.name: The Toll Baron
tollbaron.intro: The road is mine. The toll is everything you carry.

greenmother_guardian.name: The Standing Oak
greenmother_guardian.intro: You are very young, and you are standing on my roots.

cinderwyrm.name: The Cinder Wyrm
cinderwyrm.intro: It does not roar. It inhales, and the pass goes dark.

eighthlantern.name: The Eighth Lantern
eighthlantern.intro: Eight of us went out. I did not go out. I went looking.

enginewarden.name: Warden of the Ninth Well
enginewarden.intro: QUERY: WHY DID YOU WAKE ME. RESPONSE WINDOW: EXPIRED.

weighmaster.name: The Weighmaster
weighmaster.intro: Everything that crosses my pans gets weighed. You are light.

thegreatsump.name: The Great Sump
thegreatsump.intro: The pan is not empty. The pan has never once been empty.

motherbrine.name: The Mother Brine
motherbrine.intro: She has been in the ground under the pans since before the pans.

theannealer.name: The Annealer
theannealer.intro: It has been holding one temperature for six hundred years.

standingpane.name: The Standing Pane
standingpane.intro: You are looking at yourself. That is the entire trick, and it still works.

motherofglass.name: The Mother of Glass
motherofglass.intro: Nine hundred years of lightning had to go somewhere. It went into her.

theeleventhhour.name: The Eleventh Hour
theeleventhhour.intro: It shows the time. It has always shown the time. It is nearly the time.

thelonghand.name: The Long Hand
thelonghand.intro: You are not late. You were never going to be on time.

thelatebell.name: The Late Bell
thelatebell.intro: Nobody rang it. Nobody has needed to ring it for a very long time.

thefirstrank.name: The First Rank
thefirstrank.intro: Hold the line. Nobody ever came to say otherwise.

bannerofthenine.name: The Banner of the Nine
bannerofthenine.intro: Nine went down. One came back up carrying the cloth.

vergemarshal.name: The Verge Marshal
vergemarshal.intro: I have four hundred men on this rim and not one order since the Well opened.

thelongdrift.name: The Long Drift
thelongdrift.intro: The gallery does not end. That is not a figure of speech.

themotherlode.name: The Motherlode
themotherlode.intro: They dug until they hit it. Then it started digging.

theunderforeman.name: The Under-Foreman
theunderforeman.intro: Eleven years of shifts. Nobody up top ever wrote the last one down.

thegreatthirst.name: The Great Thirst
thegreatthirst.intro: It does not want to kill you. It wants what you were going to spend.

thetithe.name: The Tithe
thetithe.intro: A tenth of everything, it was agreed. Nobody agreed a tenth of what.

theopenhand.name: The Open Hand
theopenhand.intro: Give it here. You were never going to make anything of it.

whatremains.name: What Remains
whatremains.intro: It is wearing somebody. It is not wearing them well.

thetenthwell.name: The Tenth Well
thetenthwell.intro: There were nine. Somebody, at some point, dug one more.

theunwinding.name: The Unwinding
theunwinding.intro: This is not a fight. This is the last of the thread going through the eye.

thefirstengine.name: The First Engine
thefirstengine.intro: QUERY: WHO BUILT ME. NO RECORD. QUERY REPEATED FOR NINE HUNDRED YEARS.

theyardmaster.name: The Yardmaster
theyardmaster.intro: Everything that comes through the gate goes through the gate.

thebutchersbill.name: The Butcher's Bill
thebutchersbill.intro: It is a long bill, and every line of it was somebody.

thekindlyone.name: The Kindly One
thekindlyone.intro: Lie down. Everyone else did, and look how quiet they are.

thelongbarrow.name: The Long Barrow
thelongbarrow.intro: Nine hundred of them lengthways, and room yet.

theanswering.name: The Answering
theanswering.intro: Say something. It has been a very long time since anything did.

do.name: It Does Not Need To See

thegainsayer.name: The Gainsayer
thegainsayer.intro: Whatever you were about to do. Do the other one.

theacremother.name: The Acre Mother
theacremother.intro: Nine thousand of them, and she knows each one by the sound it makes.

thelastlitter.name: The Last Litter
thelastlitter.intro: It is not one thing. It has never once been one thing.

thewholeacre.name: The Whole Acre
thewholeacre.intro: The field is the animal. It has been the animal for eleven years.

theslakingpit.name: The Slaking Pit
theslakingpit.intro: Nine hundred blades went in hot. It is still not full.

thetemper.name: The Temper
thetemper.intro: It has held one temperature since before there was a word for it.

thecoldforge.name: The Cold Forge
thecoldforge.intro: No fire in it anywhere. It has been making things regardless.

theovertaking.name: The Overtaking
theovertaking.intro: It was behind you at the top of the rise. It is not, now.

thelongrun.name: The Long Run
thelongrun.intro: Nine hundred years on the same errand, and not tired yet.

theoverwind.name: The Overwind
theoverwind.intro: The spring was wound past the stop. Nobody has ever said by whom.
